analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a wait-and-see approach for 3 consecutive sessions. RSI is hovering around the neutral zone at 50.2. MACD histogram has worsened from 8799 five days ago to -959 currently, signaling a potential bearish shift. ADX remains at 9.3, indicating a lack of trend. Volatility is high with ATR at 4.93%. Given the absence of a clear direction, a cautious stance is maintained.
